about: Per-country and per-subdivision drive profiles for the L2 model (docs/v2/features/driving-time-model.md 5.1). Authored; seed rows for the countries with routed legs (CA, IT), DT-C 27 Oct 2026. Bump a row's version on any change. A subdivision row's `box` ([west, south, east, north], 0.1 degree) gives a point that arrives with no subdivision its province (RB-008, 28 Oct 2026).
licence: Legal limits are facts, cited by value. The Canada rows cite the OpenStreetMap wiki (CC BY-SA 2.0) as read on 27 Oct 2026; the generated import (legal-speeds.json, DT-P0) stays a separate attributed file and is never merged here.

rows.note: Speed limits are provincial: a point without a subdivision row has no rural limit and is estimated as rough. CA-US border default 20 min per driving-time-model.md 4.4 (a prior; live waits are a link).
